success.description: 1 4 You fold and twist the target metal object into a new shape, changing one thing into another. You can't cause the object to penetrate anything or cause damage as it changes form, and the new object must have the same encumbrance value as the original object. This spell cannot produce an item with sophisticated moving parts, but it could turn a breastplate into a greatsword, for example. The change is permanent.

boon.description: The new object created by this spell is a superior example of its type.

bane.description: If the target object is carried by an enemy, add {Dm} to the dice pool. Unusually large or complex targets may add additional difficulty at the GM's discretion.

conservative.requirements: Target metal object within close range. Must spend 2 power per encumbrance of the target.
conservative.name: Transformation of Metal

This spell cannot produce an item with sophisticated moving parts, but it could turn a breastplate into a greatsword, for example. The change is permanent.

boon.description: The new object created by this spell is a superior example of its type.

bane.description: The new item is of poor quality.

reckless.requirements: Target metal object within close range. Must spend 1 power per encumbrance of the target. Special: If the target object is carried by an enemy, add {Dm} to the dice pool. Unusually large or complex targets may add additional difficulty at the GM's discretion.
reckless.name: Transformation of Metal
